_README: Labelled from source. OrderRepository.Place runs dbo.usp_PlaceOrder through a SqlCommand with CommandType.StoredProcedure. db/procedures.sql defines usp_PlaceOrder (reads Customers in an IF EXISTS check, inserts into Orders, EXECs usp_AuditOrder) and usp_AuditOrder (inserts into AuditLog). Procedure names compare case-insensitively (T-SQL), hence the lower-cased sqlproc:: keys; table edges may come from the regex fallback (procedural T-SQL), so their floor is 0.5.

hard_case.catalog: Stored procedures: code → proc, proc → table, proc → proc (EXEC)
